Lurt 0.8.6 makes tabs draggable and the start page nicer to use.

**Download Lurt:** [Windows (lurt.exe)](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.6/lurt.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.6/lurt.exe.sha256)

No installer: download it and run it. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app isn't signed; choose **More info → Run anyway**. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 already include.

## Changed

- **Search right on the start page.** The middle search box is now a real one: type in it and get suggestions under it, without jumping to the address bar.
- **A tidier start page.** Favourites are centered, and the add button is a small round button below them that glows on hover.

## New

- **Drag your tabs.** Reorder tabs by dragging them along the strip. The order is kept between launches.

## Fixed

- **File details.** lurt.exe now shows its name, publisher and version in Properties. It is still unsigned.
